name: Sintel aligned-reference CoC diagnostic, not physical Bokeh GT or strict quality upper bound
selection: first two pilot_train sequences in existing six-family manifest; no ATB output based selection
focus: mean of original VDA q8 in native first-frame center patch x496,y202,w32,h32 /255; round5; same scalar for all25 frames and both conditions; no GT/mask or semantic subject selection
grid: native1024x436; edge-pad RGB6 top6 bottom to1024x448 (64 multiples), no resize; crop6 top/bottom for all statistics and review
geometry: A uses existing VDA q8; R uses floor(255*d_ref) only on native valid label domain; outside domain and spatial padding keep A. GT mapping fixed by dual-input-v2; no re-fit or re-focus.
condition: author WholeVid loader computes native CoC; transplant R CoC on all real slots only. RGB,K,MPI,weights,temporal padding remain A; original native8/8/9 output calls, 8-frame groups/4-overlap preserved
rng: fresh model process per scene/variant; reset global CPU/CUDA seed after loading; CPU generator seed0 per pipeline call; log posterior RNG boundaries
precision: original FP16 model, native encoder FP32 upcast; no scale1 patch, no microbatch or changed allocator
regions: pre-output native masks: valid and8px image-margin; reference nominal CoC<=0.5, (0.5,2], >2; also decrease/increase >=0.5 from original. Not object masks or Bokeh GT.
metrics: A_repeat bitwise reproducibility; R-A float/RGB8 response; inputRGB-relative MAE and gradient energy ratios in frozen masks, not perceptual quality scores; no uncompensated flicker claims
runtime_boundary: only6 diagnostic25-frame calls, no training, no other baseline runs or DAVIS heldout access; visual conclusions by user
